resources.string: ZephyrGram cannot use Google push (FCM). To deliver messages while the app is closed it keeps a connection to Telegram open through a foreground service. A small silent notification is shown while it runs. Muted chats and notification settings work as usual.
Allow unrestricted battery usage so Android does not stop the connection. This costs some battery. In the service notification settings you can lower its importance to hide the status bar icon.
%1$s devices often kill background apps. Also enable Autostart, set the battery mode to “No restrictions” and lock ZephyrGram in the recent apps list.
Silent notification shown while ZephyrGram keeps its connection open to receive messages
ZephyrGram has no Google push, so it keeps its own connection to deliver messages. Allow it to run without battery restrictions so Android does not stop it.
